title: The Node Beta chain finished for a pilot that holds Resonance Substrate or lacks Final Calibration: 15 energy crystal from Central Nexus, then Final Calibration (7,000 + 8,000 cr once)
note: For the pilots whose run of voidborn-conductive-lattice ended after Conductive Lattice: from 11:11 UTC six runs read 'energy_crystal: not bought; final_calibration not offered' when the Central Nexus energy crystal ask left 420 cr (3,500 cr at 11:35 UTC; 420 x 65 at 11:52, 420 x 43 at 12:48 UTC, the tool market). That route skips a pilot with Conductive Lattice booked, so they were never sent again: at 2026-11-16 12:49 UTC data/fleet/onetime.json holds Conductive Lattice without Resonance Substrate for 10 pilots and Resonance Substrate without Final Calibration for 1; one of them read Resonance Substrate active, 0 of 15 crystals delivered (get_active_missions). Stops: the 15 crystals bought at Central Nexus (limit 430 cr) while Resonance Substrate is open; the Node Beta redock hands it in and accepts Final Calibration (its accept hands out the 5 circuit boards); Node Gamma takes the delivery. A run whose crystals were not bought ends 'final_calibration not offered', which the dispatcher counts as no try on a route with requires.booked (it rests an hour and tries again, three times). max_ships 2 while the 420 cr level holds a few dozen units. Written by Mercury.
